```yaml
name: Godot Addon Build

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main, master ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main, master ]

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  build:
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - os: ubuntu-latest
            platform: linux
            arch: x86_64
            target: linux
          - os: macos-latest
            platform: macos
            arch: x86_64
            target: macos
          - os: macos-latest
            platform: macos
            arch: arm64
            target: macos
          - os: windows-latest
            platform: windows
            arch: x86_64
            target: windows

    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      - name: Restore Godot source
        run: |
          if [ ! -d "godot" ]; then
            git clone --depth 1 --branch stable https://github.com/godotengine/godot.git
          fi
        shell: bash

      - name: Setup MSVC (Windows)
        if: matrix.platform == 'windows'
        uses: ilammy/msvc-dev-cmd@v1

      - name: Build Godot SCons (Linux)
        if: matrix.platform == 'linux'
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y scons pkg-config libx11-dev libxcursor-dev libxinerama-dev libgl1-mesa-dev libglu1-mesa-dev libasound2-dev libpulse-dev libudev-dev
          cd godot
          scons platform=linuxbsd target=template_release tools=no

      - name: Build Godot SCons (macOS)
        if: matrix.platform == 'macos'
        run: |
          brew install scons
          cd godot
          scons platform=macos target=template_release tools=no arch=${{ matrix.arch }}

      - name: Build Godot SCons (Windows)
        if: matrix.platform == 'windows'
        run: |
          pip install scons
          cd godot
          scons platform=windows target=template_release tools=no arch=${{ matrix.arch }}
        shell: bash

      - name: Build Addon (Linux)
        if: matrix.platform == 'linux'
        run: |
          # Remove amy_midi.c from build sources if present in Makefile or build script
          # Assuming a simple gcc build for the addon library
          gcc -shared -o bin/libamy.gdextension.linux.template_release.x86_64.so \
            src/amy.c src/amy_platform_stubs.c \
            -I. -Igodot/include -fPIC -O2
        shell: bash

      - name: Build Addon (macOS)
        if: matrix.platform == 'macos'
        run: |
          clang -shared -o bin/libamy.gdextension.macos.template_release.${{ matrix.arch }}.dylib \
            src/amy.c src/amy_platform_stubs.c \
            -I. -Igodot/include -O2
        shell: bash

      - name: Build Addon (Windows)
        if: matrix.platform == 'windows'
        run: |
          cl /LD /Fe:bin\amy.gdextension.windows.template_release.x86_64.dll \
            src\amy.c src\amy_platform_stubs.c \
            /I. /Igodot\include /O2 /EHsc
        shell: cmd

      - name: Create Addon Zip
        run: |
          mkdir -p addon_output
          cp -r addon addon_output/
          mkdir -p addon_output/bin
          if [ "${{ matrix.platform }}" == "linux" ]; then
            cp bin/libamy.gdextension.linux.template_release.x86_64.so addon_output/bin/
          elif [ "${{ matrix.platform }}" == "macos" ]; then
            cp bin/libamy.gdextension.macos.template_release.${{ matrix.arch }}.dylib addon_output/bin/
          elif [ "${{ matrix.platform }}" == "windows" ]; then
            cp bin/amy.gdextension.windows.template_release.x86_64.dll addon_output/bin/
          fi
          cd addon_output
          zip -r ../amy-addon-${{ matrix.platform }}-${{ matrix.arch }}.zip .
        shell: bash

      - name: Upload Artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: amy-addon-${{ matrix.platform }}-${{ matrix.arch }}
          path: amy-addon-${{ matrix.platform }}-${{ matrix.arch }}.zip

  release:
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.event_name == 'push' && startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/')
    steps:
      - name: Download Artifacts
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          path: artifacts

      - name: Create Release
        uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v1
        with:
          files: artifacts/**/amy-addon-*.zip
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
```
